name: echo
description: Echo: A privacy-focused communication platform with real-time chat, voice, and community features.

scripts.dev: node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n backend,web,bot,activities -c auto "npm run dev -w backend" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && npm run dev -w web" "node server/ops/scripts/dev-discord-bot.mjs" "npm run dev -w activities"
scripts.dev:core: node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n backend,web -c auto "npm run dev -w backend" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:core:low-mem: node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n backend,web -c auto "npm run dev -w backend" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && npm run dev:low-mem -w web"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run lan:sync && node server/ops/scripts/compose.mjs up -d --force-recreate livekit coturn && npm run dev
scripts.prod: npm run preverify:prod && npm run build && npm run prod:serve
scripts.prod:serve: cross-env ECHO_FREE_PORTS=3000,4173,3005 node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -c auto -n backend,web,bot "cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm start" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run preview -w web" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs 127.0.0.1 4173 && node server/ops/scripts/prod-discord-bot.mjs"
scripts.prod:smoke: cross-env ECHO_FREE_PORTS=3000,4173,3005 node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -c auto -n backend,web,bot "cross-env NODE_ENV=production ECHO_REQUIRE_REDIS_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_REQUIRE_METRICS_SCRAPE_TOKEN_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_REQUIRE_MEDIA_URL_HARDENING_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_REQUIRE_GUEST_BINDING_SECRET_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_ALLOW_EMBEDDED_VIDEO_HLS=true npm start" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run preview -w web" "node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs 127.0.0.1 4173 && node server/ops/scripts/prod-discord-bot.mjs"
scripts.build:workspaces: node server/ops/scripts/copy-twemoji.mjs && node server/ops/scripts/build-emoji-secondary-aliases.mjs && node server/ops/scripts/build-emoji-search-index.mjs && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w marketing && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w bot && npm run build -w activities && npm run build -w media
scripts.test:ci: npm run format:check && npm run test:ci:guards && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 npm run build -w web && npm run build -w backend && npm run test -w web && npm run test:ci:backend && npm run test -w activities
scripts.ci:precheck: npm run test:ci && npm run lint -w web && npm run lint:theme -w web && npm run lint:style -w web && npm run lint -w backend && npm run i18n:check -w web
scripts.test:ci:guards: node server/ops/scripts/check-oss-artifacts.mjs && node server/ops/scripts/check-github-remote-policy.mjs && node server/ops/scripts/check-god-file-ratchet.mjs && npm run apple:maintainability && node server/ops/scripts/check-new-code-charter.mjs && npm run check:echo-channels && npm run check:echo-snowflake && npm run check:echo-single-reality && npm run check:echo-rbac && npm run check:channel-message-writes && node server/ops/scripts/check-echo-no-sql-in-routes.mjs && npm run check:sql-schema-columns && npm run check:voice-activity && npm run placement:check && npm run check:feature-boundaries && npm run check:dep-audit && npm run modularity:report
scripts.test:ci:backend: npm run test:storage-mode -w backend && npm run test:video-hls-worker-config -w backend && npm run test:video-hls-notify -w media && npm run test:production-config-gates -w backend && npm run test:linkUnfurlStubs -w backend && npm run test:gifProviders -w backend && npm run test:linkUnfurlExtract -w backend && npm run test:shipping-security -w backend && npm run test:security -w backend && npm run test:echo:contract -w backend && npm run test -w media && npm run check:echo-channels && npm run check:echo-snowflake && npm run check:echo-single-reality && npm run check:echo-rbac && npm run check:channel-message-writes && node server/ops/scripts/check-echo-no-sql-in-routes.mjs && npm run check:sql-schema-columns && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/paper/paperCollabState.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/paper/paperAttribution.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/platform/socketOpEnvelope.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/servers/echo.serverMemberIdsCache.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/members/echoEventUserCache.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/unfurl/unfurlCache.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/channels/echo.channelMetaCache.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/permissions/echo.permissionAggregateParity.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/servers/echo.serverAggregateCache.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/platform/keyedCoalescer.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/auth/idTokens.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/platform/gcraRateLimiter.test.ts && node --import tsx server/backend/src/tests/platform/messageRateLimiter.test.ts
scripts.test:ci:backend:integration: cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo USE_MOCK_DB=false npm run test:echo:pipeline -w backend && cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo NATS_URL=nats://127.0.0.1:4222 USE_MOCK_DB=false npm run test:echo:multinode -w backend && cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo USE_MOCK_DB=false npm run test:echo:uploads -w backend && cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo USE_MOCK_DB=false npm run test:echo:rbac -w backend
scripts.verify:ship:integration: npm run test:ci && npm run test:ci:backend:integration
scripts.ship:verify: npm ci && npm run build && node server/ops/scripts/ship-verify-smoke.mjs
scripts.redeploy:pm2: npm run build && pm2 restart echo-backend echo-video-hls-worker echo-web echo-marketing
scripts.dev:e2e: node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -k -n backend,web -c auto "cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=memory DATABASE_URL= NODE_ENV=development USE_MOCK_DB=true ECHO_GUEST_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=1 npm run dev:e2e -w backend" "cross-env VITE_ECHO_GUEST_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=1 node server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && npm run dev:e2e -w web"
scripts.test:e2e: node server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -k -s command-cypress -n stack,cypress -c auto "npm run dev:e2e" "wait-on -t 120000 http://localhost:8080 && npm run cy:run -w web"
